gizmo.title: Uhlu lokuhlola lwezinhlamvu
gizmo.description: Uhlu lwamabhokisi okumaka. Abafundi bamaka izinto futhi inqubekelaphambili yabo ikhunjulwa edivayisini yabo.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Igama lohlu. Lifundwa ngokuzwakalayo njengelebula yeqembu lamabhokisi okumaka.

configure.title: Izinto
configure.description: Into ngayinye iyibhokisi lokumaka. Izinto ezimakiwe noma ezikhutshaziwe azikwazi ukushintshwa abafundi.

configure.title: Kunezinombolo
configure.description: Bonisa uhlu olunezinombolo esikhundleni sohlu lwezinhlamvu.

developer.title: I-ID yokugcina
developer.description: I-ID eyingqayizivele esetshenziselwa ukukhumbula inqubekelaphambili yomfundi edivayisini yakhe. Ikhiqizwa ngokuzenzakalelayo; yishintshe kuphela ukuze wabelane ngenqubekelaphambili phakathi kwezinhlu noma uqale kabusha.
